title: Category totals ignore the first transaction
body: `total_by_category` in `ledger.py` always leaves out the first transaction. It skips `rows[0]` as if it were a CSV header, but the rows come from `parse_rows`, which uses `csv.DictReader` and has already consumed the header. Every transaction should be counted.
